d: The Iran war has highlighted the growing role of low-cost attack drones in modern warfare. Iran’s Shahed drones targeted military and energy infrastructure across West Asia, forcing countries to use expensive interceptor missiles to stop them. Saudi Arabia is now reportedly preparing to build similar kamikaze drones near Riyadh through a partnership involving US and Saudi defence firms. The United States has also introduced its own low-cost combat drone called LUCAS, partly inspired by Iran’s Shahed design.
